old.description: Text the file holds exactly once.

edit.description: One replacement in a text file.

base.description: The hex object ID of the commit the changes were made against. Without it the changes apply to whatever the branch holds.

name.description: The repository's name: its dev.knotless.repo record key.

branch.description: Without refs/heads/. Created when absent, from `base`, or else from the default branch's tip.

sha.description: The hex object ID of the commit, or of the branch tip when nothing changed.

parent.description: The hex object ID the commit was built on; absent for a branch's first commit.

batched.description: How many commits went out in the write that carried this one.

changed.description: False when the changes left the tree as it was, and no commit was made.

main.description: Fails with 409 when a change touches a path that moved since `base`, or when the branch kept moving under the batch.

author.description: Who the commit names as its author, when not the gateway's default.

data.description: The file's new contents; absent, with no `edits`, to delete it.

edits.description: Replacements in the file as the commit's parent holds it, made in order, when `data` is absent. The file keeps its mode. Fails with 409 when one's `old` is not in the file exactly once.

change.description: One path written, edited or deleted.

description: Commits file changes to a branch through a gateway its owner has delegated writes to, without a clone. Commits to one branch that arrive together are built into one chain and written as one ref update. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the gateway's DID, for this method; the caller must be the owner or a collaborator.
